name: Fresh Wild Pacific Cod Fillet (Oven-Baked)
whyItWorks: Pure, mild white fish containing less than 1g of fat per 4 oz serving and zero fiber. Delicate flaky flesh breaks down instantly without demanding heavy bile or pancreatic enzymes.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake fillet at 375°F in a toaster oven or standard oven with a light brush of olive oil and salt for 10–12 minutes until it flakes easily with a fork.
